highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.157.0 update corrects image-subset sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering.
highlights_body: The native Skia m157 corrections also make image-filter cache keys consistent with hashing. The managed and C API surfaces remain unchanged.

bullets.detail: Image filtering and texture sampling respect logical bounds under minification, strong skew, AA clipping and MSAA. Strict sampling constraints prevent unrelated backing-store texels from leaking into filtered images when padding is insufficient.

bullets.lead: Align image-filter cache equality with hashing
bullets.detail: Bytewise key comparison distinguishes signed-zero representations and matrix type metadata, avoiding floating-point-mode-dependent equality and keeping cache lookups and LRU eviction consistent.

Text rasterization uses the reloaded glyph's own outline when font-scaler loads change. Incompatible masks produce cleared output instead of unsafe copies or format assertions, while clipped embossed glyphs preserve full plane strides and SDF overlap remains intact.
